invariants.statement: Every observed candidate is admitted, hidden, or excluded exactly once.
Exact source evidence is closed and not materialized until an explicit user disclosure.
An incomplete client instance cannot enter the most-complete example set.
Ordinary experiment tests make no network or real-provider request.
Generated code cannot become a production client instance or recipe example.
Synthesis cannot add a repository edge absent from validated structural authority.
Unknown request-local refs have no authority and cannot survive validation.
Synthesis cannot emit a source locator or path.
Synthesis cannot omit a required formal role or introduce an unsupported semantic step.
The hidden oracle is evaluator-only and never enters extraction or synthesis input.
A standard-library helper is not a repository-owned external client boundary.
Test-only fakes and helpers cannot become production client instances.
An unreachable legacy wrapper or stale prose claim cannot become a live client instance.
